user.title: AROME Solar Forecast
user.description: PV forecast from the Météo-France AROME model (France and neighbouring areas), through Open-Meteo. More roof planes, efficiencies and shading can be set afterwards in the options.

data_description.azimuth: Direction the panels face, as on a compass: 180 = south, 90 = east, 270 = west.
data_description.inverter_kw: Maximum AC output of the inverter(s), 0 if unknown. Used for clipping.

error.cannot_connect: Open-Meteo could not be reached. Try again later.
error.outside_arome: This location is outside the AROME domain (France and neighbouring areas). Choose another model, for example best_match.
error.no_data: The model returned no data for this location. Choose another model.
error.invalid_shading: Use hour=factor pairs separated by commas, for example 8=0.7, 17=0.5 (hours 0 to 23, factors 0 to 1.5).

abort.already_configured: This PV system is already configured.

init.title: PV system
init.description: Roof planes 2 and 3 are ignored while their peak power is 0.

data_description.system_efficiency: Soiling, wiring and mismatch losses (0.98 = 2 % losses).
data_description.temp_coefficient: Power change per °C above 25 °C, from the panel datasheet (Pmax).
data_description.cell_heating: Cell temperature rise per W/m²: 0.025 open rack, 0.03 roof mounted, 0.035 roof integrated.
data_description.shading: Factors by local hour, for example 8=0.7, 16=0.5, 17=0.4. Empty = no shading.
data_description.scan_minutes: Open-Meteo is called once per roof plane at each update.
